text.p: Following is the planned timetable for the summit between U.S. President Bill Clinton and Russian President Boris Yeltsin, which starts on Thursday.
The meeting in the Finnish capital opens one day later than planned because Clinton had to undergo surgery following a knee injury last week. The main talks take place on Friday.
All times given are local, followed by GMT. THURSDAY MARCH 20
Early evening - Clinton and Finnish President Martti Ahtisaari hold bilateral meeting at presidential palace.
1900/1700 GMT - The summit officially starts with a dinner hosted by President Ahtisaari and a separate meeting between Yeltsin and Clinton. FRIDAY MARCH 21
Early morning - Ahtisaari greets both presidents at his secluded residence, Mantyniemi, and leaves them to their talks. The house is on a promontory overlooking the Baltic.
Early evening - A news conference is planned at the nearby Kalastajatorppa Hotel, close to the summit site.
2200/2000 GMT - Clinton leaves for Washington. SATURDAY MARCH 22
Yeltsin and Ahtisaari have bilateral talks over lunch at Presidential Palace. A news conference is planned to follow.
